title: Mock article / Debugging a warehouse load
summary: A synthetic troubleshooting walkthrough for exercising Article navigation.

blocks.text: Start an incident from observable symptoms, then narrow the failing boundary. Avoid changing several systems at once before you understand whether the issue is transport, schema, data quality or downstream semantics.

items: Capture the failed run ID and time window.
Compare source and landed row counts.
Check schema drift and rejected records.
Inspect transformation logs and partition/watermark boundaries.
Reconcile target counts and key uniqueness.
Only then choose replay, repair or rollback.

blocks.title: Operational rule
blocks.text: A fix is not complete until you can explain why the failure happened and how the recovery avoided additional damage.
